name: Class Critique
description: Whole-class feedback on a presentation, idea, or pitch. Students rate on three custom 1–5 scales; results show as bar charts + pie charts.
tagline: Use after a student presentation, an idea pitch, or any artifact you want structured class feedback on.

topic.label: What is being rated?
topic.helper: Describe what students should rate — a presentation, an idea, a piece of writing, etc. The teacher can also explain verbally.
topic.placeholder: Rate the presentation you just heard.

visibility.label: Who sees the results
visibility.helper: Everyone — the whole class sees averages + distribution. Teacher only — results stay on the teacher screen.

timer.label: Time to rate (seconds)
timer.helper: How long students have to fill in all three scales.

template.name: Critique: ${topic}
template.description: A whole-class critique built with the Class Critique recipe.

intro.message:
${topic}

When the presenter is done, rate it on each scale. Be honest and constructive.
